## Change

## Verification
State the test environment and observed result. Distinguish emulator tests from physical tests and report remaining checks.

## Requirements and test review
Record the tester/requirements reviewer subagent's outcome, reviewed commit, requirement and acceptance coverage, and resolution of findings. Link required check results for the current revision and identify outstanding decisions or acceptance conditions. Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#work-tracking-and-status) before merge.
